en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I...can do this...
I'll believe in myself and prove I can do this!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede...
I'm going to...keep the promise I made to you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I could have heard her play.
Just once...I wanted to hear it.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's just a monitor. Even if I investigate,
I don't think I'll find anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe there's a camera in here,
watching us... Maybe not.
